findings.statement: Lemma 2.5 proof of the approximation-number characterization does not separately handle padded indices j>min(rows,cols) before invoking the first j right singular vectors.
findings.repair: For j>min(rows,cols), s_j(T)=0 and B=T has rank<j. Then restrict the printed kernel/SVD argument to the in-range case.
findings.downstream: Lemma statement true; paper's downstream uses are in range; no constant changes.
findings.independence: Derived before peer comparison; account01/B12 later independently corroborated.

findings.statement: The displayed square-law density formula is undefined at z=v because the denominator is zero.
findings.repair: State formula for z!=v and choose any finite density version at v, e.g. p_T(v)=0; P(Y=m)=0 since Y has a density.
findings.downstream: A.e. bounds and interval-preimage estimate unchanged.
